title: Ahead of U.S. IPO, British AI neocloud Nscale secures $3.36B in convertible finacing
summary: Led by hedge fund Third Point, the new investment includes $2.36 billion available to the company immediately and an additional $1 billion coming from existing investor Nvidia, which Nscale will receive in mid-November.
